standards.name: LINCS iPSC Metadata Specification (2017)
standards.abstract: This specification defines metadata for induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) lines used in LINCS studies. It covers both canonical (line-level) and batch-specific information about iPSC lines: identifiers, provenance (precursor cell and provider), culture and passaging, genetic and molecular features, quality verification, and references. The document is a LINCS (LINCS DSGC / LINCS centers) metadata standard intended to harmonize how iPSC lines are described and tracked across centers and experiments, addressing reproducibility and data integration by prescribing a set of named fields with descriptions and importance levels.

classification.rationale: The source material is organized as a metadata table: it lists explicit, named fields (e.g. IP_LINCS_ID, IP_Name, IP_Provider_Batch_ID) with descriptions, related-to categories, comments and an importance ranking. Each row names a distinct field with a specific metadata role and expected content, i.e. genuine field-level structure.
